WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS num_films
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  ra.rating,
  ra.avg_ratio,
  ra.num_films,
  ra.avg_ratio - oa.overall_avg AS difference
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
